commits.author: Sachin Panayil

commits.message:
e2e: Add AGENCY and AI enrichment scenarios

After the push scenario, the workflow now:
- validates code.json.neutral with AGENCY=neutral
- generates from scratch with AGENCY=neutral and checks the PR's
  code.json has only neutral baseline fields
- checks that AGENCY=bogus fails
- runs ENABLE_AI on code.json.ai with SKIP_PR and ADMIN_TOKEN, and
  checks it opened a pull request carrying the AI review notice

The existing reset step already cleans up the extra pull requests and
any direct push the AI run falls back to.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
commits.author: Sachin Panayil

commits.message:
e2e: Add code.json fixture with blank enrichable fields

A copy of code.json.good with longDescription, categories, platforms,
softwareType and repositoryType blanked, so an ENABLE_AI run has real
work to do. tags is left alone: it already counts as missing with fewer
than 5 entries.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
commits.author: Sachin Panayil

commits.message:
e2e: Add neutral-schema code.json fixture

A code.json that has only the neutral baseline fields and none of the
CMS-required ones. It passes the neutral schema and fails the CMS schema,
so validating it with AGENCY=neutral only passes if the input really
switches the schema.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
